each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import json
def objects(g,bg):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; res=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i][j]!=bg and not seen[i][j]:
                st=[(i,j)]; seen[i][j]=True; cells=[]
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop(); cells.append((a,b))
                    for di in(-1,0,1):
                        for dj in(-1,0,1):
                            y,x=a+di,b+dj
                            if 0<=y<H and 0<=x<W and g[y][x]!=bg and not seen[y][x]:
                                seen[y][x]=True; st.append((y,x))
                rs=[c[0] for c in cells]; cs=[c[1] for c in cells]
                r0=min(rs); res.append((r0,min(cs),max(rs)-r0+1,max(cs)-min(cs)+1,len(cells)))
    return res

# New hypothesis H1: every multi-cell connected component (template, any colors)
# is COMPLETED: find every placement where every NON-background cell of the
# placement coincides with a same-colored cell; fill ALL remaining background cells.
# Validate on all 8 demos.
def solve(inp):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in inp for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=comps(inp,bg)
    tmpls=[norm(c,inp) for c in cs if len(c)>=2]
    out=[r[:] for r in inp]
    # collect all placements consistent with input, union-fill, avoiding conflicts between different template instances? apply sequentially; conflicts impossible since placement consistency requires colors equal.
    fills=[]
    for t in tmpls:
        tgts=[(a,b,v) for a,b,v in t]
        for ar,ac,_ in tgts:
            dy,dx=-ar,-ac
            ok=True; fills_=[]
            for da,db,dv in tgts:
                y,x=da+dy,db+dx
                cur=inp[y][x]
                if y<0 or x<0 or y>=H or x>=W: ok=False;break
                if cur==dv or cur==bg: continue
                if cur!=bg and cur!=dv: ok=False;break
                if cur==dv: pass
            if ok:
                for da,db,dv in tgts:
                    y,x=int(da+dy),int(db+dx)
                    if inp[y][x]==bg: fills_.append((y,x,dv))
                fills.append(fills_)
    for f in fills:
        for y,x,v in f: out[y][x]=v
    return out

def analyze_demo(d):
    i=G[f'Demo pair {d} input']; o=G[f'Demo pair {d} output']
    H,W=len(i),len(i[0]); bg=Counter(x for r in i for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=comps(i,bg)
    tmpls=[norm(c,i) for c in cs if len(c)>=2]
    seeds=[(c[0][0],c[0][1],i[c[0][0]][c[0][1]]) for c in cs if len(c)==1]
    print(f'--- demo {d}')
    for sr,sc,col in seeds:
        # candidate template(s) that contain color col
        cands=[]
        for ti,t in enumerate(tmpls):
            if col not in {v for _,_,v in t}: continue
            # all dihedral variants; need to find which one anchors seed correctly:
            for ot in diheds(t):
                om={(dr,dc):tv for dr,dc,tv in ot}
                for (ar,ac),cv in om.items():
                    if cv!=col: continue
                    dy=int(sr-ar); dx=int(sc-ac)
                    if any(not(0<=sr+dy+dr<H and 0<=sc+dx+dc<W) for dr,dc in om): continue
                    good=True
                    for (dr,dc),tv in om.items():
                        yy=int(sr+dy+dr); xx=int(sc+dx+dc)
                        cur=i[yy][xx]
                        if cur==bg or cur==tv or cur==col: continue
                        good=False; break
                    if good:
                        adds=frozenset((int(y-sr),int(x-sc)) for y,x in [] ) 
                        # gather actual added cells of this placement
                        plac=frozenset((int(yy-sr),int(xx-sc),o[yy][xx]) for dr,dc,tv in om.items() if tv!=col for yy,xx in [(sr+dy+dr,sc+dx+dc)])
                        cands.append((ti,len(plac),tuple(sorted(plac))))
        print(' seed',col,(sr,sc),'cands:',[(ti,n,a) for ti,n,a in cands][:5])

def solve2(i):

            for ot in dihedral_variants(t):

import json,os,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def solveV(inp, ties='maxov', rng=20):
    bg=Counter(v for r in inp for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=comps(inp,bg)
    bigs=[c_ for c_ in cs if len(c_)>=2]
    tmpl=[dihed_variants(list(c_)) for c_ in bigs]          # per-comp variant families
    singles=[(c_[0][:2],c_[0][2]) for c_ in cs if len(c_)==1]
    o=[row[:] for row in inp]
    for (sy,sx),col in singles:
        placed=[]
        for vi,tv in enumerate(tmpl):
            for k_,v in enumerate(tv):
                for dy in range(-rng,rng+1):
                    for dx in range(-rng,rng+1):
                        good=True; ov=0; cover=0
                        for ry,rx,cv in v:
                            yy,xx=dy+ry,dx+rx
                            if not(0<=yy<len(o) and 0<=xx<len(o[0])): good=False;break
                            gg=o[yy][xx]
                            if gg!=bg and gg!=cv: good=False;break
                            if gg==bg: ov+=1
                            if gg==cv: cover+=1
                        if not good: continue
                        if any(cv==col and dy+ry==sy and dx+rx==sx for ry,rx,cv in v):
                            placed.append((cover,-ov,len(v),vi,k_,dy,dx))
        if not placed: continue
        placed.sort(key=lambda p:(p[0],p[1],p[2],p[3],p[4],p[5],p[6]))
        _,_,_,vi,k_,dy,dx=min(placed)
        for ry,rx,cv in tmpl[vi][k_]:
            o[dy+ry][dx+rx]=cv
    return o

allok=True
